holderQuote: She stitches things. She’s a [Stitch Witch].
The Stitch Witch, Belavierr, heard the comment and paused as she turned. Her eyes met Califor’s.

Flesh-Giant confirmed as work of Belavierr, [Stitch Witch]. Aliases—the Spider, the Weaver of Terandria. Threadstealer. Max bounty in excess of 60,000 gold pieces. Named-rank threat. Currently not advised to pursue.
Belavierr looked at Noass. Her immortal eyes narrowed on his face. Noass shivered for a second in the broadcast—after a ten minute delay. But he kept talking.
Az’kerash voice was displeased. The former Archmage of Wistram saw Belavierr move a finger.
Perfect in every way. The [Stitch Witch] looked up.
A flaw in their creation. Belavierr looked at the Necromancer. She was interested in how he had framed that. It spoke to his…desires. A different Necromancer than the one of a decade ago, even.
Belavierr’s face went slack as her fingers missed Mrsha’s paw. Mrsha held it out—the [Stitch Witch] reached for it.
Belavierr stared up. She looked so—annoyed, disgusted, that she seemed less immortal and rather more like an Eldavin.
Yet it did not please her. The [Stitch Witch] bent down.
Enough so that the [Stitch Witch] turned around. Belavierr tilted her head left slowly.
A wall of light blocked Belavierr’s magic. She tried again, this time with tendrils that melted as they tried to get close to him.
He looked up at Belavierr. The [Stitch Witch] stared at Pawn. Her eyes focused on him. She looked at him, the simple club, and where the two Workers had stood. The barrier of light.
